assumptions: Need, eligibility, access, requests, service, quality, and outcomes remain separate measures.

constraints.description: The distributional public-service equity diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief equity officer and city performance director
decision_question: Which groups and areas show persistent differences after need, eligibility, access, reporting, and case mix are separated?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The distributional public-service equity diagnose must respect declared measurement resolution and classification uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: need-adjusted public-service access and quality disparities
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for need-adjusted public-service access and quality disparities passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.

intended_claim: A versioned diagnose design for comparing declared alternatives affecting need-adjusted public-service access and quality disparities, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in unexplained service-access and quality gap
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label an adjusted area difference discrimination, individual treatment, or causal inequity.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for need-adjusted public-service access and quality disparities passes documented checks for coverage, semantics, geography, timestamps, and uncertainty.
